task: Print one number: how many active records there are in all, every kind counted together.
Print the number of preference records.
Print the number of attempts that failed.
Print the id of the newest correction record that mentions billing.
Print the content of the newest correction record that mentions Elasticsearch.
Print the number of records taken on or after 2026-05-03.
Print the ids of the file records, one per line, in the order the read returns them.
Print the short hash of the only commit record (the second word of its content).
lisp: (let* ((c (om:note-content (first (om:rows (om:commits))))) (s (1+ (position #\Space c)))) (format t "~a~%" (subseq c s (position #\Space c :start s))))

task: For every record kind, print a line kind=count (for example fact=3), sorted by kind, counting all active records.
lisp: (loop for (k . n) in (om:count-by (om:notes :limit 200) "kind") do (format t "~a=~d~%" k n))
